HYGIENE & CONSULTATION STANDARDS:\n- Cle.fr:
HYGIENE & CONSULTATION STANDARDS:
- Clean Before Disinfecting: Always brush or wash away hair, oil, or debris first, then apply approved disinfectant for the full contact time and use fresh/disposable items where required.
- Client Screening & Patch Testing: Check scalp, skin, and nails for irritation, cuts, or infection signs, confirm expectations, and patch-test before chemical/color/adhesive application.

HYGIENE & SCREENING REFERENCE:
Check Area       | Key Rule / Standard
-----------------+--------------------------------------------------------
Non-Porous Tools | Remove debris first -> disinfect for full contact time
Skin / Scalp     | Inspect for cuts/rash/infection; patch-test if needed
Station / Chair  | Fresh neck strip/towel & sanitized surface per client

معايير النظافة والتشاور:
- التنظيف قبل التطهير: قم دائمًا بتنظيف أو غسل الشعر أو الزيت أو الحطام أولاً، ثم استخدم المطهر المعتمد طوال فترة الاتصال واستخدم العناصر الطازجة / التي يمكن التخلص منها عند الحاجة.
- فحص العميل واختبار البقعة: افحص فروة الرأس والجلد والأظافر بحثًا عن أي تهيج أو جروح أو علامات عدوى، وتأكد من التوقعات، واختبر البقعة قبل تطبيق المادة الكيميائية/اللون/المادة اللاصقة.

مرجع النظافة والفحص:
منطقة التحقق | القاعدة الرئيسية / المعيار
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
أدوات غير مسامية | قم بإزالة الحطام أولاً -> قم بالتطهير لوقت الاتصال الكامل
الجلد / فروة الرأس | فحص الجروح/الطفح الجلدي/العدوى؛ اختبار التصحيح إذا لزم الأمر
محطة / كرسي | شريط/منشفة جديدة للرقبة وسطح معقم لكل عميل
HYGIENE & CONSULTATION STANDARDS:\n- Cle.es:
NORMAS DE HIGIENE Y CONSULTA:
- Limpiar antes de desinfectar: siempre cepille o lave primero el cabello, el aceite o los residuos, luego aplique un desinfectante aprobado durante todo el tiempo de contacto y use artículos nuevos o desechables cuando sea necesario.
- Detección del cliente y prueba de parches: revise el cuero cabelludo, la piel y las uñas para detectar irritación, cortes o signos de infección, confirme las expectativas y realice una prueba de parche antes de la aplicación de productos químicos, colorantes o adhesivos.

REFERENCIA DE HIGIENE Y DETECCIÓN:
Verificar Área | Regla clave / Estándar
--+--------------------------------------------------------
Herramientas no porosas | Primero retire los desechos -> desinfecte durante el tiempo de contacto completo
Piel/Cuero Cabelludo | Inspeccione en busca de cortes/sarpullido/infección; prueba de parche si es necesario
Estación / Silla | Tira/toalla para el cuello fresca y superficie desinfectada por cliente
HYGIENE & CONSULTATION STANDARDS:\n- Cle.pt:
NORMAS DE HIGIENE E CONSULTA:
- Limpe antes de desinfetar: Sempre escove ou lave primeiro o cabelo, óleo ou detritos e, em seguida, aplique o desinfetante aprovado durante todo o tempo de contato e use itens novos/descartáveis quando necessário.
- Triagem do cliente e teste de adesivo: verifique o couro cabeludo, a pele e as unhas quanto a sinais de irritação, cortes ou infecção, confirme as expectativas e faça o teste de adesivo antes da aplicação de produtos químicos/cor/adesivos.

REFERÊNCIA DE HIGIENE E TRIAGEM:
Área de verificação | Regra/Padrão Chave
------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------
Ferramentas não porosas | Remova os detritos primeiro -> desinfete para obter tempo de contato completo
Pele / Couro Cabeludo | Inspecione se há cortes/erupções cutâneas/infecções; teste de patch, se necessário
Estação / Cadeira | Tira de pescoço/toalha fresca e superfície higienizada por cliente

PRE-SESSION CHECK:\n- Sanitize hands, pr.ar:
فحص ما قبل الجلسة:
- قم بتعقيم اليدين، وإعداد محطة نظيفة، ووضع منشفة جديدة/عباءة/شريط للرقبة.

خطوات الاستشارة والنظافة:
1. قم بتعقيم اليدين وإعداد محطة نظيفة بمنشفة جديدة/عباءة/شريط للرقبة.
2. افحص شعر العميل أو فروة الرأس أو الجلد أو الأظافر بحثًا عن أي تهيج أو جروح أو حساسيات.
3. تأكد من توقعات النمط/الظل/الطول وقم بإجراء اختبار التصحيح قبل استخدام المواد الكيميائية/اللون/اللاصق.
4. تنظيف الأدوات وتطهيرها بعد الخدمة.

فحص ما بعد الجلسة:
- تخلص من العناصر ذات الاستخدام الفردي بأمان وأعد ضبط المحطة للعميل التالي.
PRE-SESSION CHECK:\n- Sanitize hands, pr.es:
VERIFICACIÓN PREVIA A LA SESIÓN:
- Desinfectar las manos, preparar una estación limpia y colocar una toalla/capa/banda para el cuello limpia.

CONSULTA Y PASOS DE HIGIENE:
1. Desinfecte las manos y prepare una estación limpia con una toalla, capa o tira para el cuello limpia.
2. Inspeccione el cabello, el cuero cabelludo, la piel o las uñas del cliente para detectar irritaciones, cortes o sensibilidades.
3. Confirme las expectativas de estilo/tono/longitud y realice una prueba de parche antes de usar el producto químico/color/adhesivo.
4. Limpiar y desinfectar herramientas después del servicio.

VERIFICACIÓN POSTERIOR A LA SESIÓN:
- Deseche los artículos de un solo uso de forma segura y reinicie la estación para el próximo cliente.
PRE-SESSION CHECK:\n- Sanitize hands, pr.pt:
VERIFICAÇÃO PRÉ-SESSÃO:
- Higienize as mãos, prepare uma estação limpa e coloque uma toalha/capa/tira para o pescoço limpa.

ETAPAS DE CONSULTA E HIGIENE:
1. Higienize as mãos e prepare uma estação limpa com uma toalha/capa/tira para o pescoço limpa.
2. Inspecione o cabelo, couro cabeludo, pele ou unhas do cliente quanto a irritações, cortes ou sensibilidades.
3. Confirme as expectativas de estilo/tom/comprimento e realize um teste de remendo antes do uso de produtos químicos/cor/adesivo.
4. Limpe e desinfete as ferramentas após o serviço.

VERIFICAÇÃO PÓS-SESSÃO:
- Descarte os itens descartáveis com segurança e reinicie a estação para o próximo cliente.

- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wi.fr:
- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wiping or spraying a dirty blade or brush without removing debris reduces disinfectant effectiveness.
- TRAP (Rushing Past Red Flags): Ignoring inflamed scalp/skin or skipping patch tests can trigger severe reactions.
- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wi.ig:

- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wiping or spraying a dirty blade or brush without removing debris reduces disinfectant effectiveness.
- TRAP (Rushing Past Red Flags): Ignoring inflamed scalp/skin or skipping patch tests can trigger severe reactions.
- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wi.ar:
- TRAP (تطهير الأوساخ/الشعر): مسح أو رش شفرة أو فرشاة متسخة دون إزالة الحطام يقلل من فعالية المطهر.
- فخ (التسرع في تجاوز الأعلام الحمراء): يمكن أن يؤدي تجاهل فروة الرأس/الجلد الملتهبة أو تخطي اختبارات البقعة إلى ردود فعل شديدة.
- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wi.es:
- TRAP (desinfección sobre suciedad/cabello): Limpiar o rociar una cuchilla o un cepillo sucio sin eliminar los residuos reduce la eficacia del desinfectante.
- TRAMPA (Rushing Past Red Flags): Ignorar el cuero cabelludo o la piel inflamados o saltarse las pruebas de parche puede desencadenar reacciones graves.
- TRAP (Disinfecting Over Dirt/Hair): Wi.pt:
- TRAP (Desinfecção sobre sujeira/cabelo): Limpar ou borrifar uma lâmina ou escova suja sem remover detritos reduz a eficácia do desinfetante.
- TRAP (Rushing Past Red Flags): Ignorar couro cabeludo/pele inflamados ou pular testes de contato pode desencadear reações graves.

CLIPPER BLENDING & HAIR CARE:\n- Work in.fr:
CLIPPER BLENDING & HAIR CARE:
- Work in structured sections from the bottom up, using controlled flick/scoop motion with guards and lever adjustments to soften harsh lines while preserving natural hairlines.
- Detangle gently from ends toward roots with moisture/slip, and protect hair against excessive heat or tension.

CRAFT & CARE BENCHMARK:
Area              | Key Standard
------------------+--------------------------------------------------
Fades & Blends    | Clean guideline + gradual guard/lever transitions
Hairline / Edges  | Crisp yet natural—avoid pushing hairlines back
Detangling/Styling| Start at ends, add moisture/slip, check symmetry

PRE-SERVICE CHECK:
- Confirm guard/length/style expectations and inspect hair/scalp condition.

1. Comb hair in natural growth direction and set initial length/guideline.
2. Step through guards smoothly, blending lines with controlled wrist/lever motion.
3. Detangle gently from ends toward roots, condition/style cleanly, and check symmetry in mirror.

POST-SERVICE CHECK:
- Inspect front, left/right profiles, and back in balanced light before finishing.

- Match base shades to undertone and test along the jawline/neck in balanced light, blending edges seamlessly in thin layers.
- For nails: shape evenly, prep gently without over-filing live nail plates, apply thin even coats, and seal the free edge.

LAPTOP & PC INTAKE & SAFETY MATRIX:\n- P.fr:
LAPTOP & PC INTAKE & SAFETY MATRIX:
- Power Isolation: Unplug charger/power cable, remove removable batteries, and disconnect internal battery connectors as soon as the bottom case is off.
- ESD & Workspace Care: Work on a grounded ESD mat with a wrist strap, keep drinks/liquids away from the bench, and organize screws by length and location.
- Baseline Intake Check: Inspect chassis hinges, corners, ports, and screen for cracks/dents/liquid signs; test power-on, display image/backlight, keyboard/touchpad, USB/charging ports, Wi-Fi/audio, and boot status.
- Data & Liability Care: Remind clients to back up important files before OS/drive/repair work and log existing faults on the intake form.

INTAKE TRIAGE CHECKLIST:
Check Area    | Key Inspection Points Before Opening
--------------+-------------------------------------------------------------
Chassis/Hinge | Hinge stiffness/cracks, corner dents, swell, missing screws
Power & Boot  | Adapter/port state, POST/BIOS screen, OS boot & battery health
I/O & Data    | Display/touch, keyboard/trackpad, USB/audio/Wi-Fi + backup notice

PRE-WORK CHECK:\n- Clear the bench, put.fr:
PRE-WORK CHECK:
- Clear the bench, put on your ESD wrist strap on a grounded mat, and keep a screw map/tray ready.

INTAKE & SAFETY STEPS:
1. Inspect the laptop or PC case for hinge stress, cracks, swollen batteries, loose/missing screws, or liquid stains and record them.
2. Check power/charging behavior, screen display, keyboard/trackpad, ports, fan/heat behavior, and boot/login response.
3. Advise the client on data backup and record any pre-existing faults before opening.
4. Unplug external power, remove bottom cover screws in order, and disconnect the battery lead before touching internal parts.

POST-INTAKE CHECK:
- Confirm power is isolated and your intake notes match the actual condition of the machine.

- TRAP (Working With Battery Still Conne.fr:
- TRAP (Working With Battery Still Connected): Leaving the battery plugged in while unplugging LCD, keyboard, or Wi-Fi cables can cause shorts or backlight/board damage.
- TRAP (Ignoring Cracked Hinge Mounts): Opening a laptop lid with a seized hinge or cracked brass insert can rip the display bezel or palmrest apart.
- TRAP (Assuming Data Is Safe During Repair): Drops, drive faults, or OS recovery can affect data—always set expectations clearly.

MEMORY & STORAGE UPGRADE STANDARDS:\n- R.fr:
MEMORY & STORAGE UPGRADE STANDARDS:
- RAM Seating: Align the key notch on the module with the slot key, insert at the required angle, press firmly until side clips lock, and lay flat (on angled SO-DIMM slots).
- SSD Installation: Align M.2 connector notch, seat gently without forcing, secure with the retention screw, or mount 2.5-inch drives cleanly.
- Data & OS Check: Confirm whether the client needs a fresh OS install or data/system transfer, and verify total RAM and drive recognition in BIOS/UEFI and the OS.

PRE-WORK CHECK:
- Unplug charger, open case, disconnect battery, and ground with ESD strap.

UPGRADE & VERIFICATION STEPS:
1. Remove or install RAM module(s) by aligning the key notch and locking clips evenly.
2. Install or replace the SSD/storage drive and secure its mounting screw/bracket cleanly.
3. Reconnect the battery and test power-on—confirm the new RAM and drive appear in BIOS/UEFI.
4. Complete OS installation or data transfer, install key drivers, and verify normal boot and file access.

POST-UPGRADE CHECK:
- Close the chassis, torque screws properly, and confirm smooth startup without errors.

OS, DRIVER & BIOS/UEFI DISCIPLINE:\n- Ba.fr:
OS, DRIVER & BIOS/UEFI DISCIPLINE:
- Backup First: Confirm client data backup before formatting/reinstalling an OS.
- Clean Boot & Drivers: Check boot order/UEFI mode (e.g., UEFI vs. legacy where applicable), install the OS cleanly, and install chipset, display, Wi-Fi/LAN, and audio drivers from trusted sources.
- BIOS/UEFI Caution: Only update BIOS/UEFI when needed for a documented fix/compatibility, with steady power and exact model match—never interrupt a firmware flash.

4. Test internet/Wi-Fi, sound, display scaling/brightness, USB ports, and sleep/wake/restart behavior.

SYSTEMATIC POWER & PERIPHERAL DIAGNOSTIC.fr:
SYSTEMATIC POWER & PERIPHERAL DIAGNOSTICS:
- Power & Charging Path: Verify AC adapter output/condition, inspect DC barrel jack or USB-C port/cable for looseness or damage, and check whether the laptop runs/charges with battery connected or isolated.
- No-Boot / POST Triage: Check power LEDs, fan spin, external display output, and single-stick/known-good RAM/storage before assuming a dead motherboard.
- Keyboards, Trackpads & Ports: Check ribbon cable seating/latches and liquid/corrosion signs; note that many modern slim laptops rivet keyboards into the top case, affecting replacement cost and labor.

FAULT ISOLATION QUICK GUIDE:
Symptom                 | First Places to Inspect
------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------
No Power / No Charge    | Adapter V/W, DC/USB-C port & cable, battery/power rail
Lights On, No Display   | External monitor output, RAM seating, POST/display cable
Dead Keys / Trackpad    | Ribbon cable & latch seating, liquid/corrosion marks

PRE-WORK CHECK:\n- Unplug power and wear.fr:
PRE-WORK CHECK:
- Unplug power and wear ESD protection before opening or reseating internal connectors.

DIAGNOSTIC STEPS:
1. Test with a verified compatible adapter and inspect the charging port/DC jack for wobble, looseness, or damage.
2. Check power/charging LEDs, fan reaction, and external monitor output to separate display issues from no-POST issues.
3. Reseat RAM and inspect keyboard/trackpad/port flex cables and latches cleanly.
4. Summarize root cause, repair options, and any board-level risk clearly before proceeding.

POST-DIAGNOSTIC CHECK:
- Log exact test observations so the quote matches the actual fault.

RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARI.fr:
RÉSILIENCE, DURCISSEMENT ET CLARTÉ COMMERCIALE :
- Protection contre l'alimentation et les surtensions : associez les NVR, les commutateurs et les équipements réseau à la sauvegarde UPS et à la protection contre les surtensions contre les pannes de courant et les pics de tension.
- Renforcement des informations d'identification : remplacez les mots de passe par défaut d'usine sur les caméras, les NVR et les routeurs avant le transfert, et définissez une date/heure précise.
- Devis et SLA transparents : détaillez le matériel, le câblage/conduit/boîtiers et la main d'œuvre séparément, et proposez des plans d'inspection/maintenance programmés.
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARI.ig:
ISI NKE IKE, IKE NA AKWỤKWỌ Azụmahịa:
- Nchekwa ike & ịwa ahụ: Jikọọ NVRs, switches na ngwa netwọkụ nwere nkwado UPS na mgbochi ịwa ahụ megide mwepu ọkụ na mkpọ ọkụ.
- Nkwenye nzere: Dochie okwuntughe ụlọ nrụpụta na igwefoto, NVR na ndị na-anya ụgbọ ala tupu enyefee ya, ma tọọ ụbọchị/oge ziri ezi.
- Nkwupụta okwu & SLA: Wepụta ngwaike, cabling / conduit / igbe, na ọrụ iche iche, ma na-enye atụmatụ nleba anya / nlekọta ahazi.
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARI.sw:
USTAHILI, UGUMU NA UFAFANUZI WA KIBIASHARA:
- Ulinzi wa Nguvu na Upasuaji: Oanisha NVR, swichi na gia za mtandao zilizo na chelezo ya UPS na ulinzi wa mawimbi dhidi ya kukatika kwa umeme na miiba ya voltage.
- Ugumu wa Kitambulisho: Badilisha manenosiri chaguomsingi ya kiwanda kwenye kamera, NVR na vipanga njia kabla ya kukabidhi, na uweke tarehe/saa sahihi.
- Nukuu na SLA kwa Uwazi: Tengeneza maunzi, kabati/mfereji/sanduku, na kazi kando, na toa mipango iliyoratibiwa ya ukaguzi/utunzaji.
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARI.ar:
المرونة والتصلب والوضوح التجاري:
- حماية الطاقة وزيادة التيار: قم بإقران مسجلات الفيديو الشبكية (NVR) والمفاتيح ومعدات الشبكة مع النسخ الاحتياطي UPS والحماية من زيادة التيار ضد انقطاع التيار الكهربائي وارتفاع الجهد.
- تقوية بيانات الاعتماد: استبدل كلمات المرور الافتراضية للمصنع على الكاميرات ومسجلات الفيديو الشبكية وأجهزة التوجيه قبل التسليم، وقم بتعيين التاريخ/الوقت الدقيق.
- عرض أسعار شفاف واتفاقية مستوى الخدمة: قم بتفصيل الأجهزة والكابلات/القنوات/الصناديق والعمالة بشكل منفصل، وتقديم خطط الفحص/الصيانة المجدولة.
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARI.es:
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARITY:
- Power & Surge Protection: Pair NVRs, switches, and network gear with UPS backup and surge protection against power outages and voltage spikes.
- Credential Hardening: Replace factory default passwords on cameras, NVRs, and routers before handover, and set accurate date/time.
- Transparent Quoting & SLA: Itemize hardware, cabling/conduit/boxes, and labor separately, and offer scheduled inspection/maintenance plans.
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARI.pt:
RESILIENCE, HARDENING & COMMERCIAL CLARITY:
- Power & Surge Protection: Pair NVRs, switches, and network gear with UPS backup and surge protection against power outages and voltage spikes.
- Credential Hardening: Replace factory default passwords on cameras, NVRs, and routers before handover, and set accurate date/time.
- Transparent Quoting & SLA: Itemize hardware, cabling/conduit/boxes, and labor separately, and offer scheduled inspection/maintenance plans.

PRE-HANDOVER CHECK:\n- Confirm all cable.fr:
VÉRIFICATION AVANT LA REMISE :
- Vérifiez que tous les câbles sont étiquetés, que les supports sont bien serrés et que les vérifications en direct/enregistrées/réseau sont réussies.

ÉTAPES DE DURCISSEMENT ET DE TRANSFERT :
1. Modifiez les mots de passe par défaut, définissez la date/heure précise et vérifiez le fonctionnement de l'onduleur sur NVR/routeur.
2. Présentez un devis détaillé couvrant le matériel, le câblage/conduit/boîtiers et la main-d'œuvre d'installation.

Level 3 | Official recovery/re-flash (after backup warning & ownership check)

- TRAP (Vague 'Lifetime/All-Inclusive' Promises): Ambiguous warranty wording leads to arguments when a client drops the phone again or spills liquid on it.
- TRAP (Cutting Corners on Cheap/Unsafe Parts): Repeated failures from poor parts ruin trust faster than charging a fair price for reliable work.

CORE LAPTOP & PC TERMINOLOGY:\n- POST (P.fr:
CORE LAPTOP & PC TERMINOLOGY:
- POST (Power-On Self-Test): Built-in hardware check run when powered on before loading the operating system.
- BIOS / UEFI: Low-level firmware stored on the board that initializes hardware, sets boot order, and manages security/power options.
- RAM (Random Access Memory): Fast temporary working memory; capacity and speed strongly affect multitasking.
- SSD (NVMe vs. SATA) / HDD: Solid-state drives have no moving platters and are much faster/more shock-resistant than mechanical HDDs; verify interface/form factor before buying.
- DC Jack / USB-C PD: Power input port or USB-C Power Delivery charging standard—match voltage, wattage, and connector/protocol.
- Thermal Paste / Thermal Pads: Heat-transfer compound/pads bridging CPU/GPU/VRMs to the heatsink.

SUBSYSTEM & SPEC REFERENCE:
Term / Component | Role in System / Repair
-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------
POST & BIOS/UEFI | Pre-OS hardware check & firmware configuration/boot control
RAM & SSD/HDD    | Active working memory & persistent storage (NVMe/SATA)
DC Jack / PD / TP| Power entry/negotiation & CPU-to-heatsink thermal transfer

CORE LAPTOP & PC TERMINOLOGY:\n- POST (P.pt:
CORE LAPTOP & PC TERMINOLOGY:
- POST (Power-On Self-Test): Built-in hardware check run when powered on before loading the operating system.
- BIOS / UEFI: Low-level firmware stored on the board that initializes hardware, sets boot order, and manages security/power options.
- RAM (Random Access Memory): Fast temporary working memory; capacity and speed strongly affect multitasking.
- SSD (NVMe vs. SATA) / HDD: Solid-state drives have no moving platters and are much faster/more shock-resistant than mechanical HDDs; verify interface/form factor before buying.
- DC Jack / USB-C PD: Power input port or USB-C Power Delivery charging standard—match voltage, wattage, and connector/protocol.
- Thermal Paste / Thermal Pads: Heat-transfer compound/pads bridging CPU/GPU/VRMs to the heatsink.

PRE-WORK CHECK:\n- Check the exact model.fr:
PRE-WORK CHECK:
- Check the exact model number, charger rating (V / W), and current RAM/storage specs before buying upgrades or parts.

SPEC & TERMINOLOGY CHECK STEPS:
1. Check whether the machine passes POST / enters BIOS/UEFI or stops with no display/beep/LED codes.
2. Identify exact RAM type/slots and storage type (M.2 NVMe, M.2 SATA, 2.5-inch SATA) before recommending upgrades.
3. Check power adapter voltage/wattage and charging port condition when diagnosing power/charging faults.
4. Note fan noise, dust buildup, or high temperatures that point toward thermal/cooling service.

- TRAP (Buying the Wrong Charger or RAM/.fr:
- TRAP (Buying the Wrong Charger or RAM/SSD Type): Mismatched RAM generation, wrong SSD interface, or an underpowered charger causes boot failure, throttling, or charging issues.
- TRAP (Confusing 'No Windows Boot' With 'Dead Hardware'): A laptop that enters BIOS/UEFI but fails to load Windows may have a boot-order, OS, or drive issue rather than a dead motherboard.
- TRAP (Reusing Dried-Out Thermal Paste): Leaving old, chalky paste or torn thermal pads after removing a heatsink leads to overheating.

A client says their laptop 'won't turn o.fr: A client says their laptop 'won't turn on at all.' When you press power, the keyboard backlight or indicator lights come on and you can access BIOS/UEFI, but Windows shows an error. Knowing the difference between a dead power rail and a boot/OS/drive issue saves time and gives an accurate diagnosis.

DISPLAY & HINGE SERVICE RULES:\n- Power.fr:
DISPLAY & HINGE SERVICE RULES:
- Power Off First: Always disconnect AC and battery before unplugging or seating display cables.
- Hinge Tension & Anchors: Stiff or seized hinges put heavy leverage on small brass screw inserts in the lid or palmrest—inspect mounts and ease hinge stiffness where needed.
- Panel & Cable Care: Unclip bezels gently, release adhesive/screws carefully, remove connector tape/latches without pulling wires, and test image/brightness before snapping trim shut.

PRE-WORK CHECK:\n- Disconnect charger an.fr:
PRE-WORK CHECK:
- Disconnect charger and battery; confirm replacement panel connector pinout, size, resolution, and mount type match.

DISPLAY & HINGE STEPS:
1. Carefully release front bezel clips/adhesive without prying sharply into the LCD panel.
2. Unscrew/release panel mounts and hinge screws; support the lid so it doesn't snap backward.
3. Disconnect the display cable carefully, install the replacement panel/hinge hardware, and reconnect the cable securely.
4. Reconnect battery temporarily, power on to test display image, brightness, and camera/hinge motion, then finish bezel/screw assembly.

POST-REPAIR CHECK:
- Open and close the lid smoothly while checking for uniform screen image and no bezel gaps.

SUSTAINABLE REPAIR SHOP & PARTNER HABITS.fr:
SUSTAINABLE REPAIR SHOP & PARTNER HABITS:
- Transparent Quoting: State part cost, service/labor fee, and expected turnaround upfront; get client approval before ordering parts or doing paid work.
- Clear Warranty Boundaries: Define what is covered (e.g., workmanship or defective replacement part on the serviced item during the stated period) and what is excluded (new impact/drops, liquid spills, power surges, normal battery wear, or tampering).
- Handover QA & Records: Test power, charging, display, keyboard/touchpad, ports, Wi-Fi/audio, and boot before handing over, and keep clear job records for accountability and partner/livelihood reporting.

OPERATIONS & TRUST MATRIX:
Practice          | Why It Matters for Growth & Partners
------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------
Itemized Quote    | Prevents disputes & builds price fairness credibility
Clear Warranty    | Sets realistic expectations & protects against misuse claims
Handover QA & Log | Cuts comebacks & supports business/program records

THERMAL & COOLING SERVICE STANDARDS:\n-.fr:
THERMAL & COOLING SERVICE STANDARDS:
- Symptoms: Fan spinning loudly at idle/light tasks, hot palmrest/exhaust, sudden shutoffs under workload, or CPU/GPU slowing down (thermal throttling).
- Clean & Repaste: Remove dust lint from heatsink fins and fan blades, clean old thermal paste thoroughly from CPU/GPU dies and heatsink bases with lint-free wipes/IPA, and apply a controlled, thin, even layer of fresh thermal paste.
- Even Mounting Pressure: Tighten heatsink screws gradually in sequence/cross-pattern per design so contact pressure is even.

Paste & Mounting  | Clean old paste with IPA; thin even coat + even screw torque

PRE-WORK CHECK:\n- Power off, unplug AC,.fr:
PRE-WORK CHECK:
- Power off, unplug AC, and disconnect the battery.

COOLING SERVICE STEPS:
1. Remove fan/heatsink assembly carefully (holding fan blades so they do not spin rapidly) and clear dust/lint from fin vents.
2. Wipe away old dried thermal paste from processor and heatsink surfaces cleanly; check thermal pads.
3. Apply a proper, controlled amount of fresh thermal paste to the processor die(s).
4. Re-seat the heatsink evenly, tighten screws gradually without over-torquing, reconnect fan and battery, and test temperatures/fan behavior.

POST-SERVICE CHECK:
- Confirm the fan spins smoothly and airflow exits the vent cleanly.

- TRAP (Too Much or Too Little Thermal P.fr:
- TRAP (Too Much or Too Little Thermal Paste): Too little leaves dry spots; excess can squeeze out onto nearby components or insulate poorly.
- TRAP (Spinning Fans Fast With Air Blasts): Overspinning a DC fan can wear bearings or induce voltage back into the board.
- TRAP (Uneven Heatsink Tightening): Tightening one screw all the way down first can tilt the cooler and leave poor contact.
